purpose: Search and choose one option from a bounded in-memory list.
accessibility: The text input exposes combobox semantics and controls a listbox.
Loading, empty, selected, and disabled states are announced through the contract.
Arrow keys and Escape remain available for keyboard users.
responsive: Reflows within constrained containers without changing the content contract.
Retains shared control geometry and touch-target minimums.
motion: Uses shared duration and easing variables for state transitions.

api.name: options
api.description: Finite choices rendered by the control.

api.name: onValueChange
api.description: Callback fired with the next canonical value.

api.name: loading
api.description: Communicates pending work and prevents duplicate activation.
